keyword: concrete pump pipe diameter on the order

title.en: Write Pipe Diameter Only When the Xingtai Page Prints It
title.zh: 只有邢台页面印了管径，订单才写管径

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints 80 mm on Electric 20 and 100–125 mm or 100 / 125 mm on some other pages. Pages that omit diameter do not inherit a neighbour’s pipe.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的电动20印 80 mm，另一些页面印 100–125 mm 或 100 / 125 mm。没印管径的页面不继承邻页的管子。

h1.en: Put a Pipe Size on the Order Only from That Page
h1.zh: 订单上的管径只来自该页

directAnswer.en: A pipe diameter is a buying cell at Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai only when that model page prints it. Electric 20 prints 80 mm. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm. The electric mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 print 100 / 125 mm. Electric 30, Electric 40, Diesel 30 and Electric 80 do not print a delivery-pipe diameter on the lists used here. If you already own 80 mm pipe, the matching printed page is Electric 20, not a blank page you fill in yourself.
directAnswer.zh: 在河北品锦机械（邢台），管径只有该型号页印了才是采购格。电动20印 80 mm。电动15印 100–125 mm。电动搅拌泵、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 印 100 / 125 mm。电动30、电动40、柴油30和电动80在此处使用的列表上不印输送管径。如果你已经有 80 mm 管，对得上的已印页面是电动20，不是你自己填空的页面。

body.en: Among the trailer sheets used here, Electric 20 is the page that prints 80 mm. Its other buying cells are 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, hopper 0.25 m³, 120 m / 40 m, aggregate 1–2 cm, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. See [/en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/).
body.zh: 在此处使用的拖泵表里，印 80 mm 的是电动20。它的其他采购格是 22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、料斗 0.25 m³、120 m / 40 m、骨料 1–2 cm、2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、900 kg。见 [/zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-20-concrete-pump/)。

body.en: The mark 100 / 125 mm is printed on named pages only. A spare-part elbow sold as DN200 is a parts page, not a statement that every pump outlet is DN200. This buying note does not turn into a parts order.
body.zh: 100 / 125 mm 只印在点名的页面上。作为配件销售的 DN200 弯管是配件页，不是在说每台泵的出口都是 DN200。这篇采购说明不会变成配件订单。

heading.en: Inquiry when your pipe is already on site
heading.zh: 现场已经有管子时怎么询盘

body.en: Write the diameter you have and the diameter the page prints. If they differ, say so. Ask Hebei Pinjin Machinery on [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) rather than editing the sheet.
body.zh: 写上你已有的管径和页面印的管径。如果不同，请说明。请在 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 问河北品锦机械，而不是改参数页。

question.en: Does the integrated mixer print a pipe?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机印管径吗？

answer.en: Yes. 100 / 125 mm, with aggregate 4 cm and below.
answer.zh: 印了。100 / 125 mm，骨料 4 cm 及以下。

question.en: What if the cell is empty?

answer.en: Leave it empty in the catalogue copy. Describe the pipe you have as a site fact.
answer.zh: 目录摘抄保持空白。把你已有的管子写成现场事实。

question.en: Is a hose diameter on a sprayer a pump pipe?
question.zh: 喷涂机的软管直径是泵管吗？

answer.en: No. Sprayer hoses such as 32/38 mm or 38/51 mm belong to spraying machines.
answer.zh: 不是。32/38 mm 或 38/51 mm 这类软管属于喷涂机。
